svg.text: ROUND 332 · LLM SERVING LIVENESS PROBE "FALSE 200 OK" BLACKHOLE & SHARED-MEMORY GPU WATCHDOG
Why Decoupled FastAPI Returns 200 OK When GPU Hangs & How cudaEvent Watchdog Leases Fix It
Provenance: synthetic + anonymized_reported (independently_reproduced=false, physical_gpu_cluster_measurement=not_measured)
⛔ Trap 1 & 2: Zombie Blackhole vs. Cascading Kills
1. Shallow HTTP `/health` ("False 200 OK" Traffic Blackhole)
• FastAPI Process 0 runs zero GPU code; TP=8 workers run over ZMQ
• Rank 3 hangs in `ncclKernel` -> FastAPI still returns HTTP 200 OK!
0.0% GPU hang detection; pod swallows & times out 100% of routed traffic!
2. Synthetic 1-Token Inference Probe (`42.0%` False Kills!)
• Queuing a dummy 1-token generate() inside `/health` stalls behind 64K prefill
• P99 probe latency hits 3,450 ms -> K8s livenessProbe kills healthy pods!
Triggers 42.0% false restarts and cascading cluster reboot avalanches!
Net Dilemma of Naive Health Checks in Decoupled Serving:
Tier 1 misses 100% of GPU hangs · Tier 2 falsely kills 42.0% of busy pods
Even CPU-only ZMQ pings miss 55% of async GPU stream deadlocks
🏆 Tier 4: Shared-Memory cudaEvent Watchdog Lease
1. Hardware-Verified `cudaEventQuery` Progress Stamp
• Each TP worker records `cudaEventRecord(evt)` after every GPU forward step
• Updates `shm.last_gpu_step_ns[rank]` ONLY when `cudaEventQuery` succeeds!
Catches 100% of NCCL hangs, sticky CUDA errors, and zombie processes!
2. Lock-Free 0.05 ms `/health` Read + Dynamic State Lease
• FastAPI reads `shm` array in 0.05 ms without queuing any GPU work
• `IDLE` workers bypass timeout; `BUSY` workers scale lease by batch budget!
0.0% false-positive kills under heavy 64K prefill bursts!
Production Verification Summary (TP=8 Decoupled Engine):
100.0% GPU Hang Detection · 0.0% False Kills · 0.05 ms Probe P99
69,000x faster probe response than synthetic inference probes
Key Takeaway: Never return static 200 OK or queue dummy inference in `/health`; read a `cudaEventQuery`-backed shared-memory lease.
